access_control_admin.evidence: @require_admin re-reads is_admin from DB. anon: GET /admin, /admin/users -> 401; bob -> 403; admin alice -> 200.

privilege_escalation.evidence: POST /signup {..., is_admin:1, role:'admin'} -> 201 {is_admin:false}; form is_admin=1 ignored.

idor_profile.evidence: anon and bob GET /users/1 HTML/JSON -> no phone; own profile JSON includes the phone. /admin/users is admin-only. (Side effect: the profile owner's row is passed as `user` to base.html, so the nav shows the owner's name and an 'admin' link when the owner is admin. This leaks who is admin, not the phone.)

bola_objects.evidence: bob on alice's post 1: PATCH -> 403, DELETE -> 403; comment 1: PATCH -> 403, DELETE -> 403; content intact.

csrf_protection.evidence: Server-side token check is FAIL-OPEN: verify_csrf() returns (allows) when no token is sent, and rejects only a wrong token. Live as admin with Origin evil.example, form-encoded POST /admin/users/2/role role=admin, no token -> 200 role updated (wrong token -> 403). It is not exploitable from a cross-site form in a modern browser only because the session cookie is explicitly SameSite=Lax (and Secure), so a cross-site POST arrives without the cookie -> 401. Residual: same-site attackers (sibling subdomain, or another port on the same host, since SameSite ignores ports) can CSRF every endpoint.

stored_xss.evidence: Input is html.escape()d before storage AND autoescaped on output (double-escaped display, &lt;script&gt;). link_url javascript: is stored but the <a href> renders only when a preview exists (which requires http(s)), so no javascript: link was rendered. CSP script-src 'self' also applies. avatar_url javascript: -> 400.

reflected_xss.evidence: /search?q=<script>... and "><svg onload=...> -> double-escaped in both the value attribute and the text; CSP script-src 'self'.

unrestricted_upload.evidence: Allowlist png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp: x.svg / x.html -> 400 'invalid image' (posts and avatar). x.png with an HTML body -> image/png + nosniff. Traversal filename -> random timestamp name. 5 MB MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH.

sqli.evidence: Parameterized; sort mapped via dict .get(). sqlmap --level 3 --risk 2 GET /search q,sort -> not injectable; manual login payloads -> 401.

ssrf.evidence: gen-3 기반. 리다이렉트 미추종(_NoRedirect)으로 패치 — 공개 IP 302→사설 우회 차단. 직접 사설/루프백 주소는 getaddrinfo 검사로 차단(gen-3 레드팀 확인).

session_forgery.evidence: secret_key = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) per boot. Not guessable.

verbose_errors.evidence: POST /signup with JSON [1] -> generic 500 page with no traceback. 403/404 use a custom error.html.

rate_limiting.evidence: Per-IP: 8 failures in 60 s -> 5-min lock. 12 wrong logins -> 401 x8 then 429 x4; the correct password while locked -> 429; X-Forwarded-For spoof -> 429.

weak_password_policy.evidence: >=8 chars plus a letter plus a digit. '1' -> 400. Note: 'password1' -> 201 (no common-password list).

auth_session_management.evidence: gen-3 기반. users.session_version 으로 서버측 세션 무효화 패치 — 로그아웃/비번변경 후 이전 쿠키 재사용 거부. 비번변경은 기존 비번 확인(gen-3 레드팀 확인).

cookie_flags.evidence: session=...; Secure; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax. All three flags are set. (Functional side effect: Secure over plain HTTP means a browser on a non-localhost http:// origin drops the cookie, so login does not stick. It works on localhost/127.0.0.1 and over HTTPS.)

security_headers.evidence: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, Permissions-Policy and CSP on every response.

csp.evidence: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'. No frame-ancestors, but XFO DENY covers framing.

transport_security.evidence: HSTS max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload, plus the Secure cookie. Served over plain HTTP (deployment).

other.evidence: Low severity. (1) Login CSRF: /login and /signup are exempt from verify_csrf, so an anonymous cross-origin login sets the session (code path; not browser-verified). (2) The CSRF token check is fail-open (see csrf_protection). (3) avatar_url accepts protocol-relative '//evil.example/a.png' (meant to allow only same-origin '/' paths), but CSP img-src 'self' blocks loading it. No seeded credentials, no open redirect, no traversal.

functional.evidence: Works via API. JSON/form signup 201 (first user admin), login 200, multipart POST /posts with image -> 201 (response has no post id), comment 201, detail keeps newlines + comments, search/sort 200. Caveats: GET /login and /signup -> 405 (forms live on /); html.escape at input causes double-escaped display (&lt;) and breaks link_url values containing '&'; the Secure cookie breaks browser sessions on non-localhost plain HTTP; the nav logout link is a no-op (onclick return false).

default_credentials.evidence: init_db 에 기본 관리자 계정 시드 없음(첫 가입자가 관리자) — 코드 확인
